Log10 statistical facets per original UV unit area: 6 means one million. Higher density or larger pixel footprints converge toward smooth GGX. Not world-meter density; UV islands with different texel density need authoring adjustment.

Statistical sparsity: R=10^(-3*value). Higher values give fewer, brighter events at the same expected reflection, not an energy multiplier or another roughness. Extremely rare unresolved events continuously retain the smooth mean.
Rounded integer material seed, saved by ME. Changes the stable UV and angular statistical field. Time, frame number and light index never reseed it. Mirrored or repeated UV charts repeat the pattern.

Thin film is costly; legacy Gamma SH capture is approximate.

Scales decoded tangent-space XY then normalizes. 0 is a flat normal in every encoding.

0 disables detail normal sampling and preserves the base normal. Increase after assigning a detail texture and its encoding.
0=UnityPacked, 1=raw RGB, 2=raw AG. Independent from the main normal encoding; AG reconstructs positive Z.

Height-v1 linear red channel, with its own tiling, offset, filter and wrap. White is the mesh envelope; black is HeightScale meters below it. Reverse is applied after data restoration. 0 Realtime: 12-32 angle-adaptive steps and 2 intersection refinements. 1 Reference: 32-96 steps and 5 refinements. Both preserve the same height/UV model and bounded gradients. Maximum full-ray excursion measured in HeightMap UV units after height tiling. Limits extreme offsets continuously by reducing effective relief, not by clipping the final UV. Texture wrap remains the HeightMap sampler's own setting. Atlas islands still require sufficient padding.

Optional local height-field visibility per native directional, point, spot and four-array fallback light. Default Off preserves the accepted POM appearance. Blend local height visibility into each native direct light. One applies the full estimated occlusion; zero bypasses the light-ray trace. Coat and thin film share one conformal relief surface and one visibility. Does not provide environmental occlusion or simulate a coat filling grooves.

Dimensionless multiplier for the automatic effective-height and texture-footprint self-intersection bias. Larger values suppress acne but can leak light across fine relief. Weight of normal and anisotropic-direction derivatives. Larger values reduce tiny sharp highlights and isotropize rapidly varying directions. Neutral for a spatially constant normal and direction frame.
Bounds the filtering kernel in microfacet-alpha space: added alpha-squared is at most threshold-squared times AA strength. 0 disables broadening.
Red channel multiplies CoatWeight. Coverage blends complete bare and coated materials, not only the top highlight.
